content.premise: Project Frostpeak is an immersive tactical role-playing game set in the frozen ruins of the Northern kingdom of Frostpeak.
content.player_role: The player assumes the role of a legendary pathfinder aiding the Frostpeak Resistance in reclaiming their home and restoring the lineage of King Arven from the occupying forces of the Cinder Vanguard.

warnings: Human input required to confirm Eldrin's connection to Reclaim the Ash Pass quest as a proposal requiring confirmation.

content.themes: Faction choice holds high consequences for gameplay and world state flags.
content.lore_background: The story centers around the aftermath of the Ember Siege of 842. The volcanic nation of Vulcana, led by Warlord Ignis, launched an elemental assault to seize control of Frostpeak's geothermal energy and rich sky-iron deposits. Today, the Cinder Vanguard guards the mines, while rangers launch guerrilla attacks from the Ash Pass to free the frozen city.

warnings: Human input required to confirm Eldrin's formal slow ancient-lore voice as a proposal requiring confirmation.

content.visual_notes: We utilize a high-contrast color palette, pairing warm oranges and elemental reds from the Cinder Vanguard's fire engines against deep icy blues and granite grays of the frozen Northern citadel ruins. Characters have sharp, hand-painted textures that highlight the gritty, cold environment.
content.visual_theme: The visual identity of Project Frostpeak utilizes a Stylized Dark Fantasy theme.

rules: State contract version 1: clear guards and raise Northern flag as separate objectives, independent boolean flags and observable events; completion requires both flags and reevaluates on each objective update.

Structured state proposal: start an attempt active with all objective flags false. While active, each declared objective event sets only its own flag true; preserve other flags. Do not mutate a completed/failed attempt from objective events.

Completion proposal: reevaluate after each objective update; set lifecycle to completed only when all required_flags are true. Test every partial state and both action orders; event descriptions are not executable bindings or playtest evidence.
Failure proposal: while active, a declared failure event sets lifecycle to failed; preserve progress until explicit restart.

proposed_review_request.objective: Create exactly one NPC Eldrin profile, exactly three genuinely new short spoken lines (first greeting; Ash Pass reminder while either or both actions remain incomplete; completion only after both actions), and exactly one Reclaim the Ash Pass quest. Cite Eldrin's formal slow ancient-lore voice and Hook 1 mechanics. Use distinct proposed dialogue trigger mappings, one per situation. Eldrin is not assigned as quest giver in the GDD: his connection to this quest must be a clearly labelled proposal requiring confirmation. Use state_contract version 1: clear guards and raise Northern flag as separate objectives, independent boolean flags and observable events; completion must require both flags and reevaluate on each objective update. Include concrete proposed failure and explicit restart events; restart must clear both flags and reactivate the attempt. Give scene integration and manual verification steps, including zero/partial/complete states and both action orders. Include explicit dialogue repeat/reset rules as proposals; no scanner-bypass reset. Label unsupported wording, controls, flags, ordering, failure/restart rules and character-quest associations as proposals. Preserve exactly 100 gold and 250 XP, invent no extra rewards, timers, dependencies or engine IDs. runtime must be null. Keep other supported blueprint sections concise and grounded. Do not import CyberRakshak characters, locations or terms.
